title: LysoIP from iPSC-derived mDANs
author: Yu Chen
materials: Let samples cool down to room temperature.

steps.title: Prepare KPBS Buffer
steps.instruction: Prepare KPBS buffer containing protease and phosphatase inhibitors no more than 1 hour before starting the immunoprecipitation (IP).

steps.title: Prepare anti-HA Beads
steps.instruction: Prepare and wash the anti-HA beads to remove NaN3 and Tween-20.

substeps.instruction: Aliquot 150 uL of anti-HA beads into 1.5 mL tubes.
Wash the beads 3 times using 500 uL and 300 uL of KPBS + protease/phosphatase inhibitors.
Leave beads in 300 uL of KPBS + protease/phosphatase inhibitors until cell homogenates are ready.

steps.title: Harvest iPSC-derived mDANs
steps.instruction: Collect mDANs from the culture flask.

substeps.instruction: Start with 35 x 10^6 iPSC-derived mDANs in a T-175 flask per technical replicate.
Wash cells once with ice-cold DPBS and aspirate the DPBS.
Scrape mDANs off in 10 mL ice-cold KPBS buffer.

steps.title: Prepare Cell Homogenates
steps.instruction: Resuspend cells and perform mechanical homogenization.

substeps.instruction: Aspirate KPBS and resuspend pelleted mDANs in 950 uL of KPBS + protease/phosphatase inhibitors.
Save 25 uL of the suspension for Western blot as 'input'.

Homogenize for 3-5 rounds: for each round, run the homogenizer for 10 seconds at max power, waiting for bubbles to disappear between rounds. Use 15 mL conical tubes (not 50 mL) and keep samples on ice.
Add 100 µL of Lysis Buffer (2% SDS, 50 mM TEAB pH 8.5) to each technical replicate.

steps.title: Isolate Organelle-rich Supernatant
steps.instruction: Separate nuclei from the cellular organelles.

substeps.instruction: Centrifuge homogenates at 1000 x g, 4 °C, for 2 min to pellet nuclei.
Collect the supernatant (which should be cloudy and yellowish if protein concentration is high), as it contains the lysosomes.

steps.title: Perform LysoIP
steps.instruction: Capture lysosomes using the prepared anti-HA beads.

substeps.instruction: Mix the pre-washed anti-HA beads in KPBS + inhibitors with the cell homogenates for 5 minutes on a rotor at 4 °C.
Settle the anti-HA beads using a magnetic stand and transfer the supernatant to a new tube.
Wash the anti-HA beads with bound organelles 3 times with 1 mL KPBS + Protease/Phosphatase inhibitors.

steps.title: Prepare for Proteomics
steps.instruction: Proceed with the S-trap protocol to prepare the samples for proteomics analysis.
